locations.note: Incan ruins hold the first Mystic Statue, on a journey that leaves South Cape in a world mirroring ours.
The Nazca Lines are the launch point for the Sky Garden floating above them.
Angkor Wat is the dungeon where Will finds the Gorgon Flower and where the comet's past visits are revealed.
The Great Wall is one of the real landmarks that inspire a level.
The Egyptian pyramids hold the last Mystic Statue.
The finale climbs the Tower of Babel, the legendary tower, to face the comet.

routes.name: Will's journey
routes.note: Will's journey from the Incan ruins and the Nazca Lines to Angkor Wat, the Great Wall and the pyramids, ending at the Tower of Babel.
